{{Top|leg}}
The '''Council of Gordek''' was a a four member council voted for by the collective [[Orfite]] [[sahh]]s. Each member was chosen for their ability to listen and interpret the intentions of others. Members of the council were retained until the sahhs decided that a new vote should be held to determine the membership of the Council. The Council of Gordek listened to disputes between sahhs, although they had no power to mediate; rather they provided observation and insight that led to solutions. They also mediated disputes between the [[High City of Refuge]], [[Orfa City]], and other parties.
